auth.label: MCP Key
auth.description: The secret key for Sif's Amazon analysis MCP service. Create it at https://www.sif.com/mcp?tab=secret.

actions.name: call_tool
actions.description: Call a current Sif MCP Amazon analysis tool with JSON arguments after discovering its live input schema.

toolName.description: The exact tool name returned by list_tools.

arguments.description: JSON arguments matching the inputSchema returned for the selected tool.

inputSchema.description: Input for invoking one current Sif MCP tool.

result.description: The tool result. Structured MCP content is returned directly; otherwise the MCP content envelope is preserved.

outputSchema.description: The normalized result returned by the Sif MCP tool.

actions.name: list_tools
actions.description: Discover the current Sif Amazon analysis tools and their live input schemas before choosing a tool to call.

name.description: The exact Sif MCP tool name to pass to call_tool.

inputSchema.description: The current JSON Schema for the tool arguments, supplied by Sif MCP.

items.description: A tool currently exposed by the connected Sif MCP account.

tools.description: Business tools currently exposed to the connected Sif account.

outputSchema.description: The current Sif MCP business tool catalog.

actions.name: market_discover_competitors
actions.description: Analyze and filter a keyword's Top-100 competitor pool by price, review threshold, sales, and competitive posture. Costs 3 Sif points.

country.description: The Amazon marketplace code, such as US, UK, DE, or JP. Sif defaults to US when omitted.

my_asin.description: The caller's ASIN. Sif excludes it and narrows results to its competing price range.

max_results.description: The maximum number of competitors to return, from 1 to 10.

price_min.description: The minimum competitor price used to narrow the result.

price_max.description: The maximum competitor price used to narrow the result.

max_reviews.description: The maximum competitor review count used to narrow the result.

posture_filter.description: The competitive posture label used to narrow the result.

result.description: The tool result. Structured MCP content is returned directly; otherwise the MCP content envelope is preserved.

outputSchema.description: The normalized result returned by the Sif MCP tool.

actions.name: market_get_asin_aba_footprint
actions.description: Reverse-map an ASIN to search terms where it occupies an ABA Top-3 position. Costs 2 Sif points.

country.description: The Amazon marketplace code, such as US, UK, DE, or JP. Sif defaults to US when omitted.

topN.description: The maximum number of keyword records to retrieve, from 1 to 1000.

inputSchema.description: Parameters for retrieving an ASIN's ABA Top-3 footprint.

result.description: The tool result. Structured MCP content is returned directly; otherwise the MCP content envelope is preserved.

outputSchema.description: The normalized result returned by the Sif MCP tool.

actions.name: market_get_asin_keyword_signals
actions.description: Analyze an ASIN's keyword traffic contribution, organic and paid dependence, rank stability, and health signals. Costs 3 Sif points.

country.description: The Amazon marketplace code, such as US, UK, DE, or JP. Sif defaults to US when omitted.

listingSearch.description: Whether to use Sif's listing-search scope.

time_value.description: The recent-day count, Sunday week date, or first-of-month date matching time_type.

topN.description: The maximum number of keywords to return, from 1 to 300.

inputSchema.description: Parameters for analyzing ASIN keyword signals.

result.description: The tool result. Structured MCP content is returned directly; otherwise the MCP content envelope is preserved.

outputSchema.description: The normalized result returned by the Sif MCP tool.

actions.name: market_get_asin_profile
actions.description: Get product-positioning profiles such as price, rating, reviews, BSR, brand, listing age, variants, and dimensions for up to 20 ASINs. Costs 2 Sif points per input ASIN.

asins.description: One to twenty ASINs, including parent ASINs.

country.description: The Amazon marketplace code, such as US, UK, DE, or JP. Sif defaults to US when omitted.

inputSchema.description: Parameters for retrieving ASIN product profiles.

result.description: The tool result. Structured MCP content is returned directly; otherwise the MCP content envelope is preserved.

outputSchema.description: The normalized result returned by the Sif MCP tool.

actions.name: market_get_keyword_competition
actions.description: Analyze a keyword's traffic-share leaders, ABA Top-3 concentration, market accessibility, and optional ASIN competitive position. Costs 2 Sif points.

country.description: The Amazon marketplace code, such as US, UK, DE, or JP. Sif defaults to US when omitted.

time_value.description: The Sunday date for week analysis or first-of-month date for month analysis.

result.description: The tool result. Structured MCP content is returned directly; otherwise the MCP content envelope is preserved.

keywords.description: One to twenty keywords to analyze.

actions.name: market_get_keyword_history
actions.description: Get raw historical ABA search volume, rank, and Top-3 click and conversion concentration for up to 10 keywords. Costs 1 Sif point.
